toolbar.splitViewTitle: Split view: source and WYSIWYG side by side; click a pane to edit it (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E)

toc.empty: No headings yet. The TOC updates automatically as you add them.

frontmatter.empty: No metadata. Click to add YAML fields.
frontmatter.complex: Contains arrays or multiline values. Edit in YAML text.
frontmatter.invalid: Invalid YAML: must start and end with a --- fence. Original text kept.

files.openFailed: The file has been moved or deleted and cannot be opened
files.saveFailed: Failed to save. Check disk space or file permissions
files.folderOpenFailed: The folder has been moved or deleted and cannot be opened
files.removeFolder: Remove folder from list (files on disk are kept)
files.clearFoldersConfirm: Remove all open folders from the list? (Files on disk are kept)

dialog.closeBulkConfirm: {count} tab(s) have unsaved changes and will be lost. Close anyway?

linkBar.placeholder: Enter the link URL, press Enter to apply

qs.placeholder: Search files by name, Enter to open

search.noFolder: Mount a folder in the sidebar first
search.unavailable: Cross-file search is unavailable in browser mode

history.title: Version history
history.empty: No history for this file yet
history.hint: The previous on-disk content is archived before every save.
history.previewHint: Select a version on the left to preview
history.restored: Loaded into the editor; saved to disk only after you save

tt.rowDelTitle: Delete current row (deletes the table when it's the last row)
tt.colAddTitle: Insert a column to the right
tt.colDelTitle: Delete current column (deletes the table when it's the last column)

settings.title: Settings
settings.themePresetHint: Selecting a preset also applies its light/dark mode; the toolbar button toggles anytime
settings.fileThemeHint: Drop your own .css files into the themes folder — the file name is the theme name. Click Refresh after editing them externally.
settings.themeFileMissing: Theme file "{name}" no longer exists; reverted to the built-in theme.
settings.themesOpenFailed: Failed to open the themes folder
settings.lineNumbersHint: Line-number gutter in source mode (applies immediately)
settings.spellcheckHint: Flag words missing from the dictionary with a red squiggly underline (off by default; English dictionary only, Chinese is not checked)
settings.fontCustomPlaceholder: Custom font stack, e.g.: Georgia, serif
settings.typographyHint: Font size also applies to source mode; other options affect the editor only. Takes effect immediately; long lines scroll horizontally when wrap is off
settings.focusModeHint: Dim everything except the current paragraph (WYSIWYG mode only)
settings.typewriterModeHint: Keep the cursor vertically centered while typing (works in both WYSIWYG and source mode)
settings.autosaveHint: Writes saved files back to disk every 5 seconds (desktop only)
settings.imageInline: Inline in document (data URL, no file needed)
settings.imageAssets: Save to assets/ folder next to the document (save the document first)
settings.imageAssetsHint: Documents that were never saved fall back to inline mode
settings.imageHosting: Upload to image hosting (PicGo, good for sharing online)
settings.imageHostingHint: If upload fails, the image falls back to inline mode
settings.shortcutsHint: Click a key box then press a new combination (must include Ctrl/Cmd or Alt)
settings.shortcutInvalid: Shortcut must include Ctrl/Cmd or Alt
settings.updateAutoCheckHint: Automatically check for new versions on startup
settings.logsHint: Logs and crash reports stay on this device and are never uploaded.
settings.logsOpenFailed: Failed to open the logs folder
